name: We are Passengers
source:
you board a subway train just as the doors close. you are met with emptiness, silence, and a girl with no possessions. a short, surreal experience about self-doubt and running from your problems.

[from [url=https://catsket.itch.io/we-are-passengers]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当地铁门关闭时，你登上了地铁。你遇到的是空虚、沉默和一个一无所有的女孩。关于自我怀疑和逃避问题的简短而超现实的体验。

[来自[url=https://catsket.itch.io/we-are-passengers]itch.io[/url]]
